frozen.uthmani: اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيْرًا، اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيْرًا، اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَأَجَلُّ، اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ
frozen.indopak: اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ كَبِيْرًا، اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ كَبِيْرًا، اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ وَاَجَلُّ، اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ، وَلِلّٰهِ الْحَمْدُ
frozen.clean: الله اكبر كبيرا الله اكبر كبيرا الله اكبر واجل الله اكبر ولله الحمد
frozen.transliteration: Allaahu akbar kabira, Allaahu akbar kabira, Allaahu akbar wa ajall, Allaahu akbar, wa lillaahil hamd. [1]
frozen.reference:
[1] Irwa'ul-Ghalil, Albani: 3/126
[2] Bukhari 971
[3] As-ilatun wa ajbibatun fee salatil Eidain 31-32 p.

source.name: Words of Takbir #3
source.translation: Allah is the Greatest, Most Great. Allah is the Greatest, Most Great. Allah is great and Most High. Allah is the Greatest, All praise is due to Allah.
source.note:
Women will also recite this takbeer, but in a low voice. So that non mahram can't hear the sound of this takbeer. Umm Atiyah (RA) said, ‘Even we used to take menstruating women out to the Eidgah. They stood behind the men; They used to recite takbeer after hearing their takbeer and they also used to recite dua after hearing their dua. They hoped for the blessings and holiness of that day.' [2]

On the other hand, it is bid'ah to recite the takbeer of the congregation in one voice or the recitation of the takbeer by all at the same time. Since the sunnah of the Prophet (ﷺ) is: In the dhikr of Allaah, each person will recite his own dhikr alone. So it is not right for anyone to deviate from the ideals of him and his companions. [3]

source.name: Dua when meeting each other on the day of Eid
source.content: When the Companions met on the day of Eid, they would say:
source.translation: May Allah accept it (good deeds) from us and you.
source.note: In the case of plural, 'Minka' will be replaced by 'Minkum'.

frozen.uthmani: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
frozen.indopak: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا ۖ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ
frozen.clean: ربنا تقبل منا  انك انت السميع العليم

source.name: Rabbana Duas #1
source.translation: Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing.

frozen.uthmani: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
frozen.indopak: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا اُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَاَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا ۖ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيْمُ
frozen.clean: ربنا واجعلنا مسلمين لك ومن ذريتنا امه مسلمه لك وارنا مناسكنا وتب علينا  انك انت التواب الرحيم

source.name: Rabbana Duas #2
source.translation: Our Lord! Make of us Muslims, bowing to Thy (Will), and of our progeny a people Muslim, bowing to Thy (will); and show us our place for the celebration of (due) rites; and turn unto us (in Mercy); for Thou art the Oft-Returning, Most Merciful

source.name: Asking for forgiveness
source.content:
Forgiveness for sins should be sought from Allah, for the most important thing a servant can ask his Lord for, is forgiveness for his sins or its inevitable consequence. Such as deliverance from Hell and entry into Paradise. The servant needs forgiveness from his Lord for his sins, because he makes mistakes every day and night and Allah alone can forgive all sins.

The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: My heart is invaded by unmindfulness, and I ask Allah's pardon a hundred times in the day.

frozen.uthmani: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
frozen.indopak: رَبَّنَا اٰتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْاٰخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
frozen.clean: ربنا اتنا في الدنيا حسنه وفي الاخره حسنه وقنا عذاب النار

source.name: Rabbana Duas #3
source.translation: Our Lord! Grant us good in this world and good in the hereafter, and save us from the chastisement of the fire

frozen.uthmani: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى القَوْمِ الكَافِرِينَ
frozen.indopak: رَبَّنَا اَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ اَقْدَامَنَا وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَي الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِيْنَ
frozen.clean: ربنا افرغ علينا صبرا وثبت اقدامنا وانصرنا علي القوم الكافرين

source.name: Rabbana Duas #4
source.translation: Our Lord! Bestow on us endurance, make our foothold sure, and give us help against the disbelieving folk

frozen.uthmani: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا فَعَلُوا فَاحِشَةً أَوْ ظَلَمُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ ذَكَرُوا اللَّهَ فَاسْتَغْفَرُوا لِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَمَن يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَلَمْ يُصِرُّوا عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلُوا وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ ﴿١٣٥﴾ أُولَٰئِكَ جَزَاؤُهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَجَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ وَنِعْمَ أَجْرُ الْعَامِلِينَ ﴿١٣٦﴾
frozen.indopak: وَالَّذِينَ اِذَا فَعَلُوْا فَاحِشَةً اَوْ ظَلَمُوْا اَنْفُسَهُمْ ذَكَرُوا اللّٰهَ فَاسْتَغْفَرُوْا لِذُنُوْبِهِمْ وَمَن يَّغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَلَمْ يُصِرُّوْا عَلٰى مَا فَعَلُوْا وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ ﴿١٣٥﴾ اُولٰئِكَ جَزَاؤُهُمْ مَّغْفِرَةٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّهِمْ وَجَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِيْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهَارُ خَالِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا ۚ وَنِعْمَ اَجْرُ الْعَامِلِيْنَ ﴿١٣٦﴾
frozen.clean: والذين اذا فعلوا فاحشه او ظلموا انفسهم ذكروا الله فاستغفروا لذنوبهم ومن يغفر الذنوب الا الله ولم يصروا علي ما فعلوا وهم يعلمون ١٣٥ اولءك جزاءهم مغفره من ربهم وجنات تجري من تحتها الانهار خالدين فيها  ونعم اجر العاملين ١٣٦

source.name: The prayer of repentance
source.content: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If a servant commits a sin, then performs ablution properly, then stands up and prays two rak'ats and seeks forgiveness from Allah, Allah will surely forgive him." Then he recited this verse –
source.translation: (135) And those who, when they commit an immorality or wrong themselves [by transgression], remember Allah and seek forgiveness for their sins -  and who can forgive sins except Allah ? -  and [who] do not persist in what they have done while they know. (136) Those -  their reward is forgiveness from their Lord and gardens beneath which rivers flow [in Paradise], wherein they will abide eternally; and excellent is the reward of the [righteous] workers. (Sura Ali Imran 3:135-136)

frozen.uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ يَا اَللَّهُ بِأَنَّكَ الْوَاحِدُ الْأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوْبِيْ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
frozen.indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْاَلُكَ يَا اَللّٰهُ بِاَنَّكَ الْوَاحِدُ الْاَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِيْ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُوْلَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَّهٗ كُفُوًا اَحَدٌ اَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِيْ ذُنُوْبِيْ، اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ
frozen.clean: اللهم اني اسالك يا الله بانك الواحد الاحد الصمد الذي لم يلد ولم يولد ولم يكن له كفوا احد ان تغفر لي ذنوبي انك انت الغفور الرحيم
frozen.transliteration: Allaahumma inni as'aluka yaa Allahu! Bi'annakal-Waahidul-'Ahadus-Samadul-ladhi lam yalid wa lam yoolad, wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan 'Ahad, 'an taghfirali dhunubi, 'innaka 'Antal-Ghafoorur-Raheem

source.name: Seeking forgiveness by Allah's greatest name #1
source.content: The Prophet (ﷺ) performed the fajr prayer, after he said the Salam, he would say:
source.translation: O Allah, I ask of You, O Allah, as You are the One, the Only, the Self-Sufficient Master, Who begets not nor was He begotten, and there is None equal or comparable to Him, forgive me my sins, for You are the Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
source.note: Listening to his prayers, The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "He has been forgiven," three times.

frozen.uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ الْمَنَّانُ بَدِيْعُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ
frozen.indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْاَلُكَ بِاَنَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ لَا اِلٰهَ الَّا اَنْتَ الْمَنَّانُ بَدِيْعُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْاَرْضِ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْاِكْرَامِ يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ اِنِّيْ اَسْاَلُكَ
frozen.clean: اللهم اني اسالك بان لك الحمد لا اله الا انت المنان بديع السماوات والارض يا ذا الجلال والاكرام يا حي يا قيوم اني اسالك
frozen.transliteration: Allaahumma inni as'aluka bi-anna lakal-hamdu, laa ilaaha illaa antal-mannaanu badi'us-samawaati wal-ardi, yaa dhal-jalaali wal-ikram! Yaa ‘hayyu yaa qayyum! Inni as'aluka

source.name: Seeking forgiveness by Allah's greatest name #2
source.translation: O Allah, indeed I ask You since all praise is due to You, there is none worthy of worship but You, the Bestower, the Creator of the heavens and earth, O Possessor of majesty and honor, O Ever-living, O-Eternal, I am asking to You.
source.note:
It was narrated that Anas bin Malik (RA) said: "I was sitting with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and a man was standing and praying. When he bowed, prostrated and recited the tashahhud, he supplicated, and in his supplication he said: (The dua is mentioned above)

Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said: 'Do you know what he has supplicated with?' They said: "Allah (SWT) and His Messenger know best. He (ﷺ) said: 'By the One in Whose Hand is my soul, he called upon Allah by His greatest Name, which, if He is called by it, He responds, and if He is asked by it, He gives.'

frozen.uthmani: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَّنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ الْأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ اَلَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُوْلَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
frozen.indopak: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْاَلُكَ بِاَنِّيْ اَشْهَدُ اَنَّكَ اَنْتَ اللّٰهُ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ الْاَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِيْ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُوْلَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَّهٗ كُفُوًا اَحَدٌ
frozen.clean: اللهم اني اسالك باني اشهد انك انت الله لا اله الا انت الاحد الصمد الذي لم يلد ولم يولد ولم يكن له كفوا احد
frozen.transliteration: Allaahumma 'innee 'as'aluka bi'anni 'ash-hadu 'annaka 'AntAllahu laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Antal-'Ahadus-Samadul-ladhi lam yalid wa lam yoolad wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan 'Ahad

source.name: Seeking forgiveness by Allah's greatest name #3
source.content: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) heard a man saying:
source.translation: O Allah, I ask You, by the fact that I bear witness that You are Allah. There is none worthy of worship but You, the Only God, Independent of creation, Who was not begotten and begets not, and none is equal to Him.
source.note: Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, “I swear by the One in whose hand is my soul! You have supplicated Allah using His Greatest Name, when asked with this name He gives, and when supplicated by this name he answers.

frozen.uthmani: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ ﴿١٢٧﴾ رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ ﴿١٢٨﴾
frozen.indopak: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا ۖ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ ﴿١٢٧﴾ رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا اُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَاَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا ۖ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيْمُ ﴿١٢٨﴾
frozen.clean: ربنا تقبل منا  انك انت السميع العليم ١٢٧ ربنا واجعلنا مسلمين لك ومن ذريتنا امه مسلمه لك وارنا مناسكنا وتب علينا  انك انت التواب الرحيم ١٢٨

source.name: Prayers for forgiveness, loyalty and acceptance of deeds
source.translation: (127) Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing.(128) Our Lord, and make us Muslims [in submission] to You and from our descendants a Muslim nation [in submission] to You. And show us our rites and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.

frozen.uthmani: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
frozen.indopak: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَاللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ، لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهٗ، لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ، لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ
frozen.clean: لا اله الا الله والله اكبر لا اله الا الله وحده لا اله الا الله وحده لا شريك له لا اله الا الله له الملك وله الحمد لا اله الا الله ولا حول ولا قوه الا بالله
frozen.transliteration: Laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu wAllahu 'Akbar, laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu wahdahu, laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, laa 'ilaaha 'illAllahu wa laa hawla wa laa quwwata 'illaa billaah

source.name: Dua for Allah's response and forgiveness
source.translation: There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Allah is the Most Great. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, His is the dominion and His is the praise. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, there is no power and no might but by Allah.
source.note: Abu Saeed Khudri (RA) and Abu Hurairah (RA) said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said that when a servant says these words, Allah responds to him and if someone says these words while he is ill and then dies, the fire will not touch him.

frozen.uthmani: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا
frozen.indopak: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا اِنْ نَّسِيْنَا اَوْ اَخْطَأْنَا
frozen.clean: ربنا لا تءاخذنا ان نسينا او اخطانا

source.name: Rabbana Duas #5
source.translation: Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred.

frozen.uthmani: رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي
frozen.indopak: رَبِّ اِنّيْ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِيْ فَاغْفِرْ لِيْ
frozen.clean: رب اني ظلمت نفسي فاغفر لي

source.name: Seeking forgiveness #1
source.translation: My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me
